items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt list; expected to play Sunday vs. Lions.
items.why: Official activation; Schefter/Rapoport expected to play.
items.implication: RB2/flex with possible ramp-up; monitor snap share vs. committee.
items.opportunity: Lead back role likely despite layoff; Packers run game upgrade.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks ruled OUT for Monday Night Football vs. Cowboys.
items.implication: Major target vacuum for Eagles; elevates other pass catchers and Saquon receiving upside if active.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Eagles WRs/TEs; Saquon checkdowns.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs. Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again. Third straight miss.
items.why: High ankle sprain; ruled out by team/Ravens.
items.implication: Sit Lamar; Huntley streaming QB consideration; Ravens pass catchers (Flowers, Andrews, Likely) face efficiency hit without dual-threat.
items.opportunity: Reduced Ravens offense ceiling; monitor Huntley usage.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) listed QUESTIONABLE/GTD for Sunday vs. Raiders after missing Friday practice; McVay calls minor but pregame decision.
items.why: Calf issue Thursday/Friday DNP; Rapoport minor but not nothing.
items.implication: High-stakes GTD; have backup ready for 4:25 ET window. If out, TE/Higbee and remaining WRs rise.
items.opportunity: If active full WR1; if OUT massive funnel to other Rams pass catchers amid Adams OUT.

items.text: Activated and expected to play: Christian Kirk (49ers debut), Tank Dell (Texans season debut), Jordan Mason (Vikings), Jonah Coleman (Broncos).
items.implication: Kirk adds to thin 49ers WR room (with CMC upside); Dell return HOU; Mason MIN RB depth; Coleman DEN RB mix.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play Monday vs. Cowboys; DeVonta Smith OUT.
items.implication: Start Saquon if active in strong matchup; monitor final inactive.
items.opportunity: Full RB1 workload + receiving with WRs out.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (sneaky scratch); Bijan Robinson full workload expected vs. SF soft DvP.
items.why: ETR OUT list; Levitan flags as sneaky important.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate; sneaky scratches BRob/Warren/Egbuka.
items.why: Direct Levitan note on early news hope and missed scratches.
items.opportunity: Value swings on backups if outs.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) QUESTIONABLE for Sunday; limited practice return after multi-week absence.
items.implication: GTD/monitor inactive; if out Allen rises to RB1.
items.opportunity: If active committee likely; if OUT clear path for backup.

items.text: Davante Adams, Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel all OUT for Week 7.
items.why: Injury designations confirmed in ETR dump and reports.
items.implication: Major WR voids: Rams without Adams+possible Puka; 49ers WR thin (boosts CMC/Kittle/Kirk debut); Commanders without Deebo.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for remaining WRs/TEs/RBs in those offenses.

items.text: Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren among key OUTs.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury dump full list.
items.implication: KC WR void (Worthy/others); ARI RB; HOU RB (mix); TB WR; IND TE.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs/backups and remaining skill players elevated.

items.text: Tempted by CMC more slot/WR snaps amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo out, Kirk debut); rarely buys RB-as-WR but situation + Kaelon Black makes it plausible.
items.why: CMC smile/comment on gameplan; 49ers WR thin.
items.implication: CMC receiving upside spike potential; elite play even more.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets in slot for CMC; Kittle funnel.
items.conflict: Usual skepticism on RB WR alignments.

items.text: ETR Rundown for Week 7 live: game-by-game content review including injuries/projections.
Jonah Coleman should be rostered in 100% of leagues; by end of year Broncos RB you wish you had. Activated to play Sunday.
items.why: Prior production before injury; DEN backfield mediocre YPC.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins and Jordan Addison among INs/expected to play.
items.implication: Full go for CLE RB and MIN WR.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (usage @ CHI) and Tucker Kraft (@ DET TE boost; Lions allow TE TDs).
items.why: Bears good for yardage; Lions TE-friendly defense (9 TE TDs).
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share in favorable spots.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren (@ NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@ CAR) for big workloads in friendly matchups; Saquon if active.
items.why: Workloads + defenses carved by RBs; Saquon efficient + Dallas soft.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (vs NE shadow), Josh Downs (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce (@ SEA tough), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff workload questions).
items.implication: Fade/sit relative to ADP or alternatives.
items.conflict: Jacobs activation/expected play contradicts pure fade; monitor actual snaps.
